reviews.text:
It feels like we've been using your services since last summer. It's one of my dog's favorite places, and when she goes to daycare, she starts off with "Teacher! Teacher! Yay!" and has a great time. My second dog was nervous when we first arrived with our first dog, but she got used to the place after a while. When she was alone, she seemed lonely and cried a lot. That's no longer the case; she now recognizes it as a favorite place and plays with other dogs. This was our first time using a daycare communication notebook, so it's helpful to be able to see how things are going and to be able to write down anything I don't understand or ask questions verbally. It's also great that we can receive photos and videos via LINE.

You also handled our overnight stay very well and fulfilled all our requests.

We look forward to continuing to use your services in the future.

Thank you so much for your continued support!

We often use your temporary boarding service, and our dog is always overjoyed when we approach the shop! (He loves it so much that he mistakes it for a playdate, so we have to remove it from our regular walking route...)
The free-roaming environment is great, but I can always feel at ease knowing that the staff are so kind and treat my dog ​​with such love and care! I also really appreciate that they notice even the smallest changes in my dog's condition. Thank you so much for everything!
I'm happy that they let the dogs play in a free space, which is rare in this area. I also appreciate being able to get advice on training.

We always use your grooming and daycare services.

The staff are all very kind, and I always look forward to receiving the many photos you take each time. 😊
Seeing my dog ​​looking so happy makes me feel very at ease leaving him with you. 😌
Thank you again for everything.

Hello.
Thank you for always taking care of my pet's grooming and overnight stays. I really like how clean the place is and how spacious the play area is.

Thank you so much for carefully listening to my requests regarding the haircut and for taking such adorable photos afterwards!

There was also a staff member's dog there, and my dog ​​seemed so happy playing with a friend!

I will definitely use your services again!

Thank you for always making me look so cute.

The photos with the changing backgrounds each month are absolutely adorable.
The staff are very kind and are happy to accommodate sudden reservations, making it a very safe place.
We stayed at the hotel, and my child seemed very happy because they let him play with his friends during the day! We would like to use it again.
I'm glad I used it. My child was happy to see such a cute card.
